# Completed Trip GPX Scenario Fixtures

These GPX files are fixture-only stand-ins for completed user trips.
They are post-analysis evidence inputs and are not runtime safety truth.

| Scenario | Name | Content | Fitness profile | GPX |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| completed_halfway_return | 半途放棄折返 | 使用者出發後體能儲備快速下降，在接近中段前判斷後續行程風險過高，於同一路廊折返；中途有短暫休息，回程速度略恢復但整體仍偏慢。 | low_reserve_return | `completed_halfway_return.gpx` |
| completed_novel_overlap_chain | 交疊路線拼接的新走法 | 使用者沿 golden route 出發後，接上多條 historical GPX 的交疊走廊，形成沒有單一先例 GPX 的完成路線；路線切換處有額外判斷與停留。 | routefinding_moderate | `completed_novel_overlap_chain.gpx` |
| completed_delayed_emergency_camp | 行程延宕後緊急紮營 | 使用者完成主要路線，但中段因體能耗損與行程延宕，在非原定位置緊急紮營；隔日恢復後繼續前進，但後段仍保持保守速度。 | fatigue_emergency | `completed_delayed_emergency_camp.gpx` |
| completed_weather_camp_hold | 氣候因素營地停留多日 | 使用者體能狀態尚可，但遇到天候因素而在營地停留數日；天候轉好後重新出發，後續採保守速度完成路線。 | weather_hold_good_reserve | `completed_weather_camp_hold.gpx` |
| completed_normal_golden | 正常完成 golden 行程 | 使用者依照 golden route 正常完成行程，包含兩個計畫中的紮營休息點；整體 pacing 穩定，代表較好的訓練與體能儲備狀態。 | trained_steady | `completed_normal_golden.gpx` |

Each GPX is retimed with a fixture fitness profile. The manifest records
per-band distance, ascent, descent, moving duration, and hold duration so
Capability Timeline tests can exercise different fitness states.

Waypoint `cmt` and `extensions/scout_note` entries may contain
`SCOUT_NOTE_JSON` reaction records. These are recorded results from the
completed-trip scenario: Ln state records, warning records, skill outcomes,
voice cue records, outbound drafts, provider status, and Pydantic AI prompts.
Loading a scenario may replay/render these records, but must not call live
`/safety/*`, mutate Ln state, run skills, call models, play TTS, send outbound
messages, or write Brain facts.

Generated by:

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ./venv/bin/python tools/generate_completed_trip_gpx_scenarios.py
```
